correctness.rationale: Exact space has 3^15=14,348,907 ternary states indexed by the 15 two-subsets of six points, with neighbors precisely disjoint pairs (degree six). The single-valued synchronous update gives a finite functional digraph. Removing all indegree-zero states leaves only directed cycles; following every remaining cycle and unwinding deletions labels all starting states by least period and entry distance. Independently wrote and compiled a C++17 exhaustive successor/peeling/cycle/S6 quotient implementation: it visited all 14,348,907 states and obtained 1 fixed cycle, 1,258,232 period-three cycles, 90 period-four, 180 period-seven, max transient 10 with 1,440 states, and all 26 (t,p) counts; exhaustive S6 action on 270 long-cycle representatives gives orbit sizes 45,45 and 180. Graph automorphism S6 follows from six maximum intersecting families of size five (stars). No infinite-family extrapolation.
